goal.title: All 17 fields: walk to field + gather + walk home, Natro 1:1
goal.summary: All 17 path-out routes pass. Tonight (9:35 PM PT, hive 3, 60-second gathers, one loop per field) the routes branch with the Pine Tree fix (#103) walked home on all 16 target fields, and Pine Tree walked home 3 of 3 with 3-minute gathers. The routes are now merged into main (PR #2). Coconut stays WIP (the crab kills the alt every time; Natro has no crab avoidance either). Next: pattern, convert and rotation checks in game, after the AI video ships if the game isn't free sooner.

now.task: Hand-checking model v13 labels on about 400 Pine Tree and 200 Bamboo frames from footage v4 and v5, relabeling Melody, to build training set v12
now.detail: Model v11 caught under 85% of every token type (Honey 74%, Token Link 55%, Focus 50%), and no bombs or Inspire were found in v4, so more labeled examples are needed before any video.

now.task: Waiting for training set v12 to fine-tune a new model (v14); retrain starts automatically when v12 is posted
now.detail: Model v13 finished training (overall score 0.646 vs 0.585 for v11), and 15 minutes of new Pine Tree footage (v5) was recorded and uploaded.

done.title: First in-game test of the rebuild movement: all trips out reached their fields; walks home Dandelion 3/3, Sunflower 2/3, Rose 2/3, Pine Tree 1/3. Misses being looked into.

Recovery (PR #16) passed its laptop soaks: 60 minutes of Pine Tree gathering with no false stops, restarts or travel misses (walked home 3/3), and after Roblox was killed it rejoined and was gathering again about 5 minutes later. Found one bug: if the alt already owns a hive, the startup claim wastes about 2.7 minutes.
Rebuild phase 5 (part 1) merged into the rebuild branch: all 12 cannon legs, a tool to measure cannon landings, and a flaky app test fixed. Full test suite passed.
Rebuild phase 4 merged into the rebuild branch: the gather loop now runs the new hand-written legs (in studs), plus cannon steering. Full test suite passed. In-game test on the laptop is next.
Rebuild phase 1 merged into main: new movement core that measures walks in studs at the live speed. Laptop in-game test: 7/7 walks ended back on the hive pad, timing within 0.5%.

AI Gathering video saved: apex_ai_gathering_final_v3.mp4 (1:53, alt, Pine Tree then Bamboo, click held, no jumping, closer camera, bold labels). Boxes Focus, Blue Boost, Honey, Melody, Surprise Party, Treat, Bubble, Balloon and Sprinkler; Token Link, bombs, Haste, Inspire and Gumdrops didn't show up in these takes.
